propositions: The code-review sidecar correctly preserves verification blocks in 97.5% of findings (3,583 of 3,673 REVIEW_RESULT events), but no alerting or logging mechanism exists to detect when a Pass-2 verified finding unexpectedly lacks a verification block.

Findings without verification blocks are either DET-tier deterministic detectors or indeterminate LLM-tier findings with reason='no-verification', which legitimately never enter Pass-2 verification and should not trigger an error signal.

The error signal must be scoped to LLM-tier decided findings (excluding indeterminate/no-verification cases) to avoid false alarms on routine runs, and must only fire when verify_requests > 0 and at least one expected finding lacks a truthy verification block.
The coverage[metrics] dict must include a verification_recorded boolean that is False with a WARNING when the signal condition is met, and True otherwise or when Pass-2 made zero requests.
